outcome_reason: Retrospective validation is inconclusive and fails pre-registered decision gates. Available verified held-out data size (n=7) falls well short of pre-registered sample size target (n >= 30). Observed ThermoMPNN rank correlation on held-out variants with controls is rho = -0.071 with 95% bootstrap CI [-0.765, +1.000], which spans zero. Statistical power analysis demonstrates that n=7 only provides 80% power to detect extreme effects (|rho| >= 0.886). Consequently, candidate variants cannot be validated by computational prediction alone. Pre-registered protocol locks manuscript framing to AUDIT-ONLY.

disclosed_deviations.actual_execution: n = 5 primary stability variants (n = 7 including controls)
disclosed_deviations.rationale: Severe scarcity of non-overlapping single-mutant experimental literature data for IsPETase; all available verified variants exhausted without lowering threshold.
Hardware / memory constraints in local execution environment; smaller model evaluated as exploratory zero-shot prior.

disclosed_deviations.pre_registered_threshold: FoldX, Rosetta ddg_monomer, or PROSS consensus (thresholds_v2.json)
disclosed_deviations.rationale: FoldX requires academic license key; Rosetta requires massive binary distribution. Documented honestly as unavailable.

disclosed_deviations.pre_registered_threshold: 3 x 100 ns explicit solvent MD for candidates passing Phase C (thresholds_v3.json)
disclosed_deviations.actual_execution: Halted before candidate MD; only WT 6EQE minimization/equilibration verified
disclosed_deviations.rationale: Pipeline halted strictly at Phase C gate per pre-registered protocol. Candidate MD was not executed because candidates did not earn advancement.
